purpose: bounded private image-access and decoding pilot before any quantitative external inference
selection_rule: 10 lowest image-ID SHA256 ranks per known recording key plus14 for null bucket; night only; no GT/model use

transport.required: HTTPS, verified partial-range206/Content-Range and stable server identity

checks: Exact selected member mapping or stop; no substituted frames
Native PNG decode and annotation dimensions
Byte/time cap includes failed response bodies; private files only
exclusions: All64 planned pilot image paths excluded from later quantitative image pool regardless of retrieval success; no head outputs or target tuning
stop: Stop at completion, first transport/identity/CRC/decode failure, or cap; preserve partial evidence without an upload/repair loop
licence: Accepted for research, citation required, no redistribution; images need separate explicit authorization
